scope: Original teaching explanations and adapted practice; not a verbatim replacement of the book or an official mark scheme.

corrections.issue: Repeated teacher primary key and a duplicate Maths subject label in Table 8.11
corrections.treatment: Use unique teacher keys and consistent illustrative subject rows; do not copy the anomalous printed rows.
Retain ClassID FK to preserve the Student–Class relationship.

corrections.issue: CHRACTER typo, inconsistent Licence Number spelling and incomplete FK syntax
corrections.treatment: Use consistent identifiers, explicit types and parenthesised FOREIGN KEY columns.

corrections.issue: AND in SELECT output list and NUL in COUNT explanation
corrections.treatment: Use comma-separated column expressions and distinguish COUNT(*) from COUNT(column), excluding NULL values from the latter.

corrections.issue: Unquoted strings/ambiguous date literals and DELETE described as deleting the whole table
corrections.treatment: Quote text, use ISO-formatted dates, and distinguish deleting rows from dropping the structure.

verification.browser: Linear next/previous flow, bilingual explanation, 2NF/3NF before-and-after tables, foreign-key rejection, mobile layout, first-attempt preservation and study completion.
verification.data_contract: 33 Hodder key terms mapped to 14 lessons; printed pp.196–216 covered; 8.2/8.3 examples grounded in pp.208–214

limitations: Written explanations use explicitly labelled self-assessment, not automatic grading.
Detailed attempts are saved in browser storage under the signed-in user ID. Successful student completion is also sent to the existing progress endpoint.
SQL result walkthroughs show SQLite-verified fixed examples; they are not a live query editor.
The prior Chapter 8 source layers remain for the existing Past Papers route; Study and Presentation use the new course.

pedagogy_revision.reason: Learner feedback: explanations and navigation were too difficult.
pedagogy_revision.sequence: Table -> separate-file problems -> linked tables -> keys -> relationships -> 1NF -> 2NF/3NF -> DBMS -> security/query processor -> SQL -> DDL -> SELECT -> aggregates/DML -> assessment.
pedagogy_revision.method: Concrete example before terminology; short bilingual explanations; worked answer before practice; one linear Next/Previous path.
pedagogy_revision.coverage: All 33 terms remain. Full source-aligned explanations, complete SQL, and original extension exercises remain under clearly labelled deeper-study sections.
pedagogy_revision.completion: Study completion is reading, attempting checks, and reviewing the recap. It is not a mastery score; first attempts remain separate from revisions.
pedagogy_revision.integration: Incorporates fe47f0c: retains refreshed detailed explanations, updated source references, progressive E-R and introductory SQL explorers, and the CI SQL regression runner. v4 isolates rewritten task evidence from previous versions.
